zh: a group of four poems by T S Eliot, Burnt Norton (1935), East Coker (1940), The Dry Salvages (1941) and Little Gidding (1942). The poems contain Christian religious messages, and deal with themes such as time, nature, history and human experience. The titles refer to places that had a special meaning in Eliot's life or his Christian beliefs.

zh: a British comedy film (1994) in which Hugh Grant plays a young man who falls in love with an American woman at a friend's wedding. They continue to meet at other weddings and social events, and although she marries somebody else, they are together at the end of the film.

zh: 四维的（包括长、宽、高和时间）；四度空间的

zh: 方形坚固的；方方正正的
坚决果断的；坚定不移的
en: square in shape, solid and strong
ex: a four-square Georgian house
格鲁吉亚四平方的房子

en: having four stars in a system that measures quality. The highest quality is shown by either four or five stars.
ex: a four-star hotel
四星级宾馆

en: with a piston that makes four up and down movements in each power cycle

zh: 停车前行路口，四岔停车路口（有路标提示车辆先停再行驶）
en: a place where two roads cross each other, at which there are signs indicating that all vehicles must stop before continuing
ex: The first vehicle to stop at a four-way stop has right of way.
第一辆在四向停车处停车的车辆拥有通行权。
